messages.subject: Loading Data from R package Drops NA's
messages.subject_clean: Loading Data from R package Drops NA's
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have time series data in an R package that is padded with missing values (NA's) to make it a full year.  When I load the data by clicking on the .rda file in the data folder it loads the data with the missing values (I saved it using devtools "use_data" command).  However, if I try and load the data by referencing the package name, e.g., package::datafile, the data gets loaded without the missing values.  Is there a command or additional argument necessary to avoid having the NA's truncated when the data is loaded this way?   Any insights would be much appreciated.

Thanks,

Colin

messages.body_plain:
Hi Colin,

It's much more likely that you have an older version of the package
installed. R does no transformation of the data stored in data/

Hadley

messages.subject: install.libs.R and system.file
messages.body_plain: I am developing a package which builds a command line executable in src/ and then installs it to bin/ with install.libs.R. When not using devtools, the executable is installed to $SITE_LIBRARY/pkg_name/bin/exe_name and found with system.file('bin', exe_name, package=pkg_name). However, things break when devtools inserts the shim for system.file because when the package is built the executable isn't installed to local inst/bin. What's the recommended way to handle this? Currently I've had to turn off the "Use devtools package functions if available" to build and test my package.
